content: Before proceeding to the description of our word embeddings approach, it is useful to first explore the corpus through commonly used measures of disagreement, namely Wordscore and Euclidean distance. Further, the network polarization measure known as modularity is also used to explore the levels of polarization exhibited in roll call data versus speeches. First, a bag-of-words (BOW) representation of the speeches is obtained through tokenization, stemming, removal of stop words, conversion to lower case, and the removal of punctuation, symbols, and numbers. We keep only the features which appear at least 5 times in 3 documents and apply term frequency-inverse document frequency (TF-IDF) weighting to the matrix. This yields a document term frequency matrix for each year.
